sourceNote: Enhanced expansion, 30 packs x 5 cards. Site sample: 600 BOX. Per box: SAR ~20%; 3 AR GUARANTEED (site quotes ~25% per specific AR across 12 types); SR ~75% (45 Pokemon + 30 Supporter); UR ~10%. This is Raging Surf's own table — the set had previously been conflated with SV4a. RR at ~4.5/box is carried over from the identical tally structure the same site reports for sibling sets (Night Wanderer, Inferno X) rather than stated for this set — RR averages under a dollar in Japanese sets, so the EV riding on this extrapolation is a few dollars a box. Rates come from ポケゲトちゃんねる (pokemon-infomation.com), which aggregates real box-opening tallies from card shops and individuals — the closest thing Japanese sets have to a primary study, since neither The Pokemon Company nor any English source publishes Japanese odds. Confidence is MEDIUM: the samples are large (hundreds to thousands of boxes) and the methodology is consistent across sets, but the underlying tallies are not independently auditable. Per-pack probabilities are the site's per-BOX figures divided by the box's pack count, which is separately sourced. NOTE ON GUARANTEES: the per-box guarantees (1 SAR/box on High Class, 3 AR/box, 1 ACE/box etc.) are folded into the slot rates above rather than modelled as engine floors — a floor attaches to a PRODUCT, so a single-pack product would inherit the whole box's guarantee and read absurdly positive. The rates are per-box tallies divided by pack count, so a box's EV already reflects every guarantee.
